Regional Transportation Improvement Program amendment. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Deane
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-48 approving an amendment to the Regional Transportation Improvement Program.
2015-08-26 Item 8A - Regional Transportation Improvement Program
8B.
Construction contract for the annual Storm Drain Rehabilitation/Repair FY2015-16 Project (CD05E). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Hefner
1) Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, to execute a contract with Nuline Technologies, LLC in the amount of $526,506 plus 15% contingencies to construct the Annual Storm Drain Rehabilitation/Repair FY2015-2016 project, for a total contract amount not to exceed $605,482; and 2) Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, to amend Nuline Technologies, LLC contract to extend completion dates if necessary.
2015-08-26 Item 8B - Annual Storm Drain Rehab Repair
9.

The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Consideration of issuing 2015 Encinitas Public Financing Authority Lease Revenue Bonds Series A for the purpose of fully refunding the 2006 Encinitas Public Financing Authority Lease Revenue Bonds Series A (Library Bonds). Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Approve all of the legal documents as to form, subject only to any changes to the documents directed by Bond Counsel; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2015-56, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ENCINITAS AUTHORIZING PROCEEDINGS AND AGREEMENTS RELATING TO THE REFINANCING OF THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE PUBLIC LIBRARY APPROVING ISSUANCE AND SALE OF BONDS BY THE ENCINITAS PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY, APPROVING AN OFFICIAL STATEMENT AND AUTHORIZING OFFICIAL ACTIONS."
2015-08-26 Item 10A - Library Bonds Refunding
10B.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-05, which proposes changes to the City's density bonus ordinance to implement California density bonus law. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Zoning Ordinance and Local Coastal Program. Project #14-202 POD. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Open public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and 3) Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2015-05 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Chapter 30.16.020.C [Density Bonuses Pursuant to Government Code Section 65915] of the Encinitas Municipal Code" as reflected in Attachment A for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report.
2015-08-26 Item 10B - Density Bonus Ordinance
10C.
City Council reconsideration of actions taken on July 16, 2014 relating to the application and/or interpretation of the City's policies and state density bonus law. Contact Person: Barbara Kautz, Special Counsel
a) Directed staff to follow Municipal Code Section 30.16.010(B)(1), which provides for rounding down when the base density results in a fractional unit. b) Required that any affordable dwelling units included in a density bonus project must be at least 75% of the size of the market rate units, and at a minimum must meet the standard set forth in the Inclusionary Housing ordinance. c) Waiver requests based on physical infeasibility must be accompanied by sufficient documentation to demonstrate the claim of infeasibility. If the City determines that a smaller unit size could be accommodated without the waivers, such waivers should be denied. If the developer requests an incentive based on financial infeasibility, the City must require financial documentation to justify the request. d) Directed staff to implement these policies effective immediately and shall be applied to any projects not yet permitted or holding vested rights; and 4) Direct staff to continue to utilize the provisions of the City's existing Municipal Code in calculating Maximum Allowable Residential Density and to ensure that density bonus applications fully comply with the provisions of Government Code Section 65915.
2015-08-26 Item 10C - Density Bonus Policy Reconsideration
10D.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-14 which proposes changes to the City's inclusionary housing regulations to better address the need for affordable units reserved in new development projects. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Zoning Ordinance, Subdivision Ordinance and Local Coastal Program. Project #15-162 POD. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Open public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; 3) Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2015-14 titled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, repealing Chapter 24.21 of the Encinitas Municipal Code [Dedication Affordable Housing Assistance] and adding Chapter 30.41 [Affordable Housing]" for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report; and 4) Direct staff to investigate and determine the scope and feasibility of developing an 'affordable housing development impact fee' for new construction similar to the City of Carlsbad. Direct staff to present their findings to the Planning Commission for consideration and discussion.
2015-08-26 Item 10D - Inclusionary Housing Ordinance
10E.
Public Hearing regarding the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance 2015-15, Option A or B, to consider a Zoning Code Amendment to Title 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Home Depot Specific Plan, to amend the definition of 'Net Acreage' to specify that detention basins and wetlands (rather than significant wetlands) are excluded from net acreage. Sections being considered for amendment include Section 30.16.010(B)(2) and 30.04 (Chapter Definitions) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and Section III.F.1.a of the Home Depot Specific Plan. Project #14-177 POD. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Open public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and 3) Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2015-15 titled (Option B), "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Title 30, Zoning, of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding the Provisions for Net Acreage (Chapter 30.16)."
2015-08-26 Item 10E - Net Acreage Ordinance 2015-15
10F.
Council to consider possible options for a local ordinance that regulates the size of single-family homes to make them more consistent with existing neighborhoods, similar to the ordinances adopted by the City of Los Angeles and City of Solana Beach. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive report; 2) Receive and consider public testimony; and 3) Provide direction to staff as appropriate.
2015-08-26 Item 10F - Mansionization Ordinance

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
